name: qvac-translatepsy-afrislm-demo
description: A demo of TranslatePsy-AfriSLM, QVAC's translation model for 19 Sub-Saharan African languages: paste text or photograph a page and read it in your language, entirely on-device. Pairs the model with a QVAC vision model for the scan path, and uses assessModelFit to pick the size the machine can hold. No cloud, no API keys, no account.
author: QVAC by Tether
